say:1:1033213001:1.text: No. They never used to come here.
say:1:1033213001:1.source_cn: 不，他们以前根本不会来这里。
say:1:1033213001:1.male: No. They never used to come here.
say:1:1033213001:1.female: No. They never used to come here.

say:2:1033213002:1.text: This place is close to Lunadorf, and it was always the Dusk Patrollers around here. I don't know why many Thorned Guards have been showing up recently.
say:2:1033213002:1.source_cn: 这里离月湖村很近，一直都是薄暮巡游队在附近巡查，不知道...
say:2:1033213002:1.male: This place is close to Lunadorf, and it was always the Dusk Patrollers around here. I don't know why many Thorned Guards have been showing up recently.
say:2:1033213002:1.female: This place is close to Lunadorf, and it was always the Dusk Patrollers around here. I don't know why many Thorned Guards have been showing up recently.

say:3:1033213003:1.text: And they've been patrolling too... I hope there won't be any problems.
say:3:1033213003:1.source_cn: 而且他们一直在巡逻……希望不是出了什么问题。
say:3:1033213003:1.male: And they've been patrolling too... I hope there won't be any problems.
say:3:1033213003:1.female: And they've been patrolling too... I hope there won't be any problems.

say:4:1033213004:1.text: Speaking of which, the corruption has become more serious recently. I hope it won't affect our daily lives too much...
say:4:1033213004:1.source_cn: 说起来，最近腐化也变严重了，但愿别影响到我们的正常生活……
say:4:1033213004:1.male: Speaking of which, the corruption has become more serious recently. I hope it won't affect our daily lives too much...
say:4:1033213004:1.female: Speaking of which, the corruption has become more serious recently. I hope it won't affect our daily lives too much...
